name: tenantry
description: Chrome-Erweiterung (MV3) zur parallelen Nutzung mehrerer Microsoft-365-Tenants in isolierten Containern

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add static/manifest.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../tenantry-$npm_package_version.zip . && echo tenantry-$npm_package_version.zip
